title: AURA — Open Technical Specification for Verifiable Origin Declarations and Asset Integrity (v1.2.1)
description: AURA is an open technical specification for signed origin declarations, asset integrity and independent verification across digital content types. Version 1.2.1 clarifies the one-way mapping of a signed TDM reservation to the binary reserved-rights value and the exact-byte scope of asset binding. It does not add a discovery mechanism or change the v1.0 or v1.1 manifest schemas, canonicalization, signatures or existing signed evidence.
